about: P68 live check: 2 P68 dev sentences of the game through the AI version on the eval ledger (evals/play/p61/shots.mjs serve, VERCEL_ENV=production, astra as reader and director). quick = the quick game, reading = the game after reading (only when the reading picks another genre), ai = the director's AI version.

rows.sentence: a game of minigolf on a pirate island course, putting the ball past cannons and treasure chests into the hole
rows.note: Run 1 (serve --cap-usd 0.3 --director-cap-usd 1.2): one director call (49 822 prompt tokens, 0.536 USD) and two repair calls (0.065 USD together).

rows.sentence: a crazy golf course in a haunted mansion where the ball has to roll past sliding coffins into the hole
rows.note: Run 2, a fresh server (serve --cap-usd 0.05 --director-cap-usd 0.93, so the eval book stays under 5 USD). In run 1 the reading kept minigolf, but the director call was refused by the process cap: d09 had spent 0.60 of 1.2 USD and the call reserves its worst case (~0.9 USD), so it ended MODEL_UNAVAILABLE after 3.2 s. Run 2: one director call (0.536 USD), no repair.

spend.book: R7 1.81 + R9 1.47 + R12 1.27 = 4.55 of the 5 USD eval cap (the book is per process, the total is tallied here).
